English: To achieve the optimal planting density for groundnut, sow one seed per hole at an inter-row spacing of 30cm and intra-row spacing of 15cm (or 45cm inter-row and 10cm intra-row for easier weeding); do the first weeding between 20 and 50 days after planting, depending on local weed growth.

English: To free cassava cuttings of mealybugs before planting, heat water until it is too hot to hold a finger in for more than five seconds (about 60C), then dip the cuttings in this hot water for one minute only - do not soak longer, as this can kill the cuttings too.
